svg.text: TVD limiter family follow-up: one bounded lane is not enough
At CFL 0.95, TVD MC cuts the Gaussian L2 error to 0.0003, beating Lax-Wendroff's 0.0005 on this bounded smooth pulse.
On the square pulse, TVD Superbee pushes the bounded edge further, dropping L2 error to 0.0402 versus MC's 0.0482 and minmod's 0.0559.
The useful read is the split itself: MC is the calmer smooth-wave limiter, Superbee is the sharper bounded jump limiter.
